podcast.body: Composed by Lionel Richie and Michael Jackson and produced by Quincy Jones, this song brought together numerous artists in 1985. Its purpose was to raise funds for campaigns addressing the severe famines that plagued the 1980s. Released in early 1985, the song achieved immediate global success, topping the charts in virtually every country worldwide. On April 5, 1985, it was featured in a monumental event where it was simultaneously broadcast on 5000 radio stations around the globe. For many people over 30, the song evokes strong childhood memories and holds deep sentimental value. "es ridículamente el guía de muerte que cambiaron todos los artistas juntos en 1985."

This star-studded single was famously ejected from the number one spot on the charts by Madonna's "Crazy for You" in May 1985, a "giant killing feat." Madonna was notably not invited to participate in this charity project. "Finally, in May, Crazy for you ejected USA for Africa's We Are the World from the number one spot."
